editorial_thesis: The fresh advantage is not more autonomous behavior alone: it is a verifiable path from trusted context, through bounded action, to transparent customer-facing evidence.

topic_groups.title: Frontier Agent Runtime
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A new long-context flagship arrived with an immediate API migration edge and a managed coding surface; this is a material update, not a repeat of prior MCP or delivery coverage.

sources.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
sources.why_selected: Anthropic released Opus 5 as a flagship for long-running agents, emphasizing verification, iteration, coding, automation, and adjustable effort.
sources.usefulness: Use it to test difficult Buildn/client tasks where a self-checking agent could replace repeated human re-prompting: migrations, debugging, research synthesis, and browser verification.

sources.title: Claude Opus 5 Now Available in GitHub Copilot
sources.why_selected: GitHub is gradually exposing Opus 5 across Copilot surfaces for Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise; managed plans require an admin policy toggle.
sources.usefulness: Run the same bounded code task through a familiar Copilot surface before changing any agent harness or developer workflow.

sources.title: Claude Platform release notes — July 24
sources.why_selected: The API release adds claude-opus-5 with 1M context and effort tiers, allows mid-conversation tool changes in beta, and removes Opus 4.7 fast mode.
sources.usefulness: Audit direct API callers for speed=fast, then use effort as a deliberate quality/cost dial in a test harness.

topic_groups.title: Agent Knowledge + Trust
topic_groups.selection_rationale: This deliberately rotates toward an under-covered data-contract lane: agents need inspectable provenance and authorization boundaries before they can safely act on operational knowledge.

sources.title: OKF v0.2 adds trust signals
sources.why_selected: Google’s Open Knowledge Format v0.2 adds optional provenance, generated/verified, stale_after, status, and attestation vocabulary to Markdown/YAML knowledge bundles.
sources.usefulness: Create a small Buildn project-context bundle for one client: canonical metrics, runbooks, ownership, source links, and a re-verification date.

sources.title: Open Knowledge Format reference implementation
sources.why_selected: The public reference repository provides the concrete spec, samples, and tooling context behind OKF rather than leaving the trust model as a blog concept.
sources.usefulness: Use it to keep agent-readable context portable across tools instead of embedding key operating facts in a single vendor workspace.

sources.title: ORDS 26.2 MCP support for agentic database access
sources.why_selected: Oracle REST Data Services 26.2 can act as an MCP server: authorized agents can list databases, inspect schema metadata, and run SQL/PLSQL under granted privileges.
sources.usefulness: The tool split is a useful pattern for client data work: discover, inspect, then act—each bounded by an existing identity and role.

topic_groups.title: Agentic Marketplaces + Transparency
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Customer-facing agents and AI-generated media are becoming operationally visible. This lane connects the action surface, the evidence surface, and a realistic discovery workflow for client work.

sources.title: Ask Google to call local businesses for you
sources.why_selected: Google updated its U.S. agentic-calling guidance: Search or AI Mode can gather local stock and discount information, call relevant businesses, then send a summary by text or email.
sources.usefulness: For local-service clients, use this as a discovery cue: map which inventory, availability, and FAQ answers are structured enough to survive agent-mediated shopping.

sources.title: Google signs EU AI Act Transparency Code of Practice
sources.why_selected: Google signed the EU code on transparency of AI-generated content and points to C2PA and SynthID as interoperable provenance/watermarking mechanisms.
sources.usefulness: Add a client-content delivery field for origin, editing method, approval owner, and retained source assets—especially for generated visual or audio work.

sources.title: Ask Claude about the Anthropic Economic Index
sources.why_selected: Anthropic added a Claude connector that lets users query its Economic Index data and inspect the underlying data and limitations in conversation.
sources.usefulness: Use it as a hypothesis generator for client discovery: ask where AI usage is concentrated in an industry, then validate with customer interviews and first-party analytics.

sources.title: Google Search I/O 2026: AI agents and more
sources.why_selected: Google outlined AI Mode search agents, agentic booking, multimodal query input, and information agents that monitor needs over time.
sources.usefulness: Design client pages so an agent can recover the same decision facts a person needs: service scope, location, price basis, availability, proof, and a direct action route.
